hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook that implements permissionless 1:1 ETH↔phiEth swaps by intercepting beforeSwap, taking the input from the PoolManager, depositing/withdrawing via the phiEth contract, and settling the output — bypassing concentrated liquidity entirely. Direct liquidity additions are blocked, and only ETH/phiEth pools with zero fee may use this hook.
